$comment: drain.mqAggregateJobs: nonempty array of at most 16 plain job names, at most 80 characters each (ASCII letters/digits, spaces, underscores and hyphens; starts with a letter/digit). Standard default: ["test", "coverage-merge"]. Resolve standard → platform drain → tool drain → WE_DRAIN_MQ_AGGREGATE_JOBS (JSON array), logging effective value and source through policy-cascade; invalid overrides fall back to the next valid layer. Match the final workflow-qualified check name exactly. Fetch bounded Actions job metadata using the repository-validated details_url job ID, never the check-run ID. Require matching Actions job ID, completed failure status/conclusion, job name and merge-group head SHA and a nonempty readable steps array with at least one failure of the designated dependency step and containing only passing/skipped/neutral steps or the exact dependency-only failed step (test: Gate on shard results; coverage-merge: Require successful shards). Intrinsic failures and unreadable/invalid metadata require ordinary log evidence. Derived aggregates skip log reads; at least one non-derived failure must remain and every non-derived failure must satisfy existing infrastructure evidence rules. Aggregate-only failures hold for operator inspection and manual enqueue. Keep the ten-failed-job cap before any metadata/log read and the shared 20-call evidence budget (including metadata, logs and main pages); exhaustion holds for operator inspection. Accepts and declines name skipped derived aggregates and the deciding main run. drain.mqCancelledRetryMax: safe integer from 1 through 2 inclusive, standard 2; standard → platform drain → tool drain → WE_DRAIN_MQ_CANCELLED_RETRY_MAX, with effective value and source logged through the drain cascade. Invalid overrides fall back to the next valid layer. Exception to the main-green and historical removal caps: a complete check-run list with at least one cancelled/startup_failure check permits cancelled/regroup retry on a CLEAN PR only when each such check passes the same inspectMqReruns validation as failures (matching head commit, repository-bound details_url run/job identity, completed status, valid timestamps and attempt identity), and every other non-passing check is a configured aggregate with conclusion failure proven derived by the same job identity, commit binding and dependency-step metadata validation above. No timed_out or other failure qualifies. Repeated failed attempts or incomplete/pending reruns reported by inspectMqReruns hold. No logs, rerun requests or main CI reads for this kind. Count AddedToMergeQueueEvent after the first failed removal on this head; hold at the configured limit and require operator inspection and manual enqueue. Unreadable or incomplete evidence holds. drain.mqEjectAfterFailures: safe integer 1 through 3, standard 1; standard → platform drain → tool drain → WE_DRAIN_MQ_EJECT_AFTER_FAILURES, effective value and source logged through the drain cascade, invalid overrides fall back. Number of failed attempts of one merge-group job (same Actions run and check name, GitHub Actions app, repo-bound details_url, ordered by job id and cross-checked against strict timestamps) tolerated before the PR is held; at 1 the historical single-rerun behaviour is unchanged and the hold or retry line carries an mq-flake-shadow token showing what 3 would have decided. Any id-order versus time-order disagreement or missing time refuses.
